answer: A coastal organ loft starves clone keys with one scarce reed slot. The key locks 49 units and draws pipe P=H(key||watch) mod 64, a unique hollow reed with an ivory collar that cannot be reissued. In 18 minutes it must sound the reed at 3.2 Hz while the roof vane records a gale in the 12-28 m/s band, then publish H(collar||trace||key). Two loft peers replay the traces and attest only if the serial is unused and the hash matches. A missed window, reused collar, or bad wind file burns 17 units and bars the key 9 epochs; a peer signing two pipes in one watch is fined 85 units and frozen 11 epochs.
